<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="th">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#0a1020">
  <title>บันทึกยอดโอน — EDC Glass</title>
  <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="favicon-32.png">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="192x192" href="icon-192.png">
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="apple-touch-icon.png">
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="ยอดโอน">
  <meta name="application-name" content="บันทึกยอดโอน">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Prompt:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
  /* ============================================================
     THEME TOKENS — Aero / Liquid Glass
     ============================================================ */
  :root{
    --bg-1:#070c18; --bg-2:#0b1424;
    --aurora-1:rgba(56,189,248,.30);
    --aurora-2:rgba(139,92,246,.26);
    --aurora-3:rgba(16,185,129,.20);

    --glass:rgba(24,36,58,.62);
    --glass-2:rgba(30,44,70,.78);
    --glass-brd:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    --glass-brd-str:rgba(255,255,255,.28);
    --sheen:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.16) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 42%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%);
    --inner-light:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    --shadow-lg:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    --shadow-md:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.42);

    --text:#f4f8ff; --text-muted:#93a6c4; --text-soft:#c7d4ea;

    --c-sky:#38bdf8; --c-blue:#2563eb; --c-violet:#8b5cf6;
    --warning:#f59e0b;
    --radius:22px; --radius-sm:15px;
  }

  body.light-mode{
    --bg-1:#e9f0fa; --bg-2:#dce7f7;
    --aurora-1:rgba(56,189,248,.55);
    --aurora-2:rgba(167,139,250,.45);
    --aurora-3:rgba(52,211,153,.38);

    --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.62);
    --glass-2:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
    --glass-brd:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    --glass-brd-str:rgba(255,255,255,1);
    --sheen:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.75) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 42%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 62%);
    --inner-light:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    --shadow-lg:0 18px 40px rgba(30,58,110,.18), 0 4px 10px rgba(30,58,110,.10);
    --shadow-md:0 10px 26px rgba(30,58,110,.14);

    --text:#101a2e; --text-muted:#5b708f; --text-soft:#2b3c56;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:'Prompt',sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--bg-1),var(--bg-2));
    color:var(--text); overflow:hidden;
    transition:background .35s ease,color .35s ease;
  }

  /* แสงออโรร่าพื้นหลัง */
  .aurora{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;}
  .aurora i{position:absolute;display:block;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.95;}
  .aurora i:nth-child(1){width:60vw;height:60vw;background:var(--aurora-1);top:-18vw;left:-14vw;animation:drift1 18s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .aurora i:nth-child(2){width:52vw;height:52vw;background:var(--aurora-2);top:22vh;right:-20vw;animation:drift2 22s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .aurora i:nth-child(3){width:58vw;height:58vw;background:var(--aurora-3);bottom:-22vw;left:8vw;animation:drift3 20s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes drift1{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translate3d(6vw,4vh,0) scale(1.12)}}
  @keyframes drift2{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1.05)}50%{transform:translate3d(-7vw,-5vh,0) scale(.92)}}
  @keyframes drift3{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(.95)}50%{transform:translate3d(5vw,-6vh,0) scale(1.1)}}

  /* โครงหน้าจอ */
  .container{
    position:relative; z-index:1;
    max-width:520px; margin:0 auto;
    height:100dvh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);
  }
  .view-section{
    display:none; flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0;
    overflow-y:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; overscroll-behavior:contain;
    padding:14px 14px calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  }
  .view-section.active{display:block;animation:fadeUp .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1);}
  .view-section::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0}

  @keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @keyframes popIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92) translateY(6px)}70%{transform:scale(1.02)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
  @keyframes popCheck{0%{transform:scale(0) rotate(-40deg)}60%{transform:scale(1.12) rotate(6deg)}100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}}
  @keyframes drawCheck{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
  @keyframes ripple{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.55}100%{transform:scale(2.1);opacity:0}}
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
  @keyframes shimmer{0%{background-position:-200% 0}100%{background-position:200% 0}}

  .glass{
    position:relative;
    background:var(--glass);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(180%);
    backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(180%);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg), var(--inner-light);
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .glass::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sheen);pointer-events:none;}

  /* HEADER */
  .header{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0ea5e9 0%,#3b82f6 45%,#7c3aed 100%);
    color:#fff;padding:20px 18px;border-radius:var(--radius);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(37,99,235,.42), 0 6px 14px rgba(124,58,237,.30), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55), inset 0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
    margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  }
  .header::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.35),rgba(255,255,255,.05) 46%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%);pointer-events:none;}
  .header::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:190px;height:190px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);top:-72px;right:-56px;filter:blur(2px);}
  .header-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;z-index:2;}
  .header-info h1{font-size:23px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;position:relative;z-index:2;text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.28);}
  .header-info p{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#eaf4ff;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:3px;}

  .btn-theme{
    flex:0 0 auto;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.24);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);
    color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
    position:relative;z-index:2;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), 0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  .btn-theme svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
  .header-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;position:relative;z-index:2;flex:0 0 auto;}

  /* CARD หลัก */
  .card{padding:20px 18px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .card > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .section-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:13px;}
  .section-label span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
  .section-label svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
  .action-buttons-right{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;}
  .btn-chip{
    width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;
    background:var(--glass-2);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;position:relative;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-md), var(--inner-light);
  }
  .btn-chip::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:var(--sheen);pointer-events:none;}
  .btn-chip svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .btn-card-scan{color:var(--c-violet);}
  .btn-phone{color:var(--c-sky);}
  .btn-card-scan.has-data{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#a78bfa,#7c3aed);border-color:#c4b5fd;}
  .btn-phone.has-data{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#38bdf8,#0284c7);border-color:#bae6fd;}
  .status-dot{position:absolute;top:-3px;right:-3px;width:12px;height:12px;background:#22c55e;border-radius:50%;display:none;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);z-index:2;}
  .has-data .status-dot{display:block;}

  /* ปุ่มหน้าจ่าย / น้ำมัน */
  .grid-pumps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  .grid-oils{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  .grid-pump-btn,.grid-oil-btn{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--glass-2);color:var(--text-soft);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);height:54px;border-radius:16px;
    font-size:18px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-md), var(--inner-light);
  }
  .grid-oil-btn{font-size:16px;}
  .grid-pump-btn::after,.grid-oil-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sheen);pointer-events:none;}
  .grid-oil-btn.disabled{opacity:.22;pointer-events:none;filter:grayscale(100%);}
  .grid-pump-btn.active{
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,#7dd3fc,#0ea5e9 55%,#0369a1);color:#fff;border-color:#bae6fd;
    box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(14,165,233,.55), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75), inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  .grid-oil-btn.g95.active{
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fdba74,#f97316 55%,#c2410c);color:#fff;border-color:#fed7aa;
    box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(249,115,22,.55), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  .grid-oil-btn.e20.active{
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,#6ee7b7,#10b981 55%,#047857);color:#fff;border-color:#a7f3d0;
    box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(16,185,129,.55), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  .grid-oil-btn.b7.active{
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,#93c5fd,#3b82f6 55%,#1d4ed8);color:#fff;border-color:#bfdbfe;
    box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(59,130,246,.55), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }

  /* ช่องจำนวนเงิน */
  .amount-wrapper{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .amount-input{
    width:100%;height:72px; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,8,20,.55),rgba(2,8,20,.30));
    border:2px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:18px;
    font-size:34px !important;font-weight:700 !important;color:#38bdf8 !important;text-align:center;
    padding:0 54px; box-shadow:inset 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    cursor:pointer; user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; transition: .3s;
  }
  .amount-input.locked {
    opacity: 0.65; background: rgba(2,8,20,0.85) !important; cursor: not-allowed; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1) !important;
  }
  body.light-mode .amount-input{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(226,236,250,.85));
    color:#0369a1 !important; box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px rgba(30,58,110,.14), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,1);
  }
  body.light-mode .amount-input.locked { background: rgba(226,236,250,0.85) !important; opacity: 0.7; }
  .amount-input.placeholder{color:var(--text-muted)!important;opacity:.55;font-weight:600!important;}
  .btn-clear-input{
    position:absolute;right:16px;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#64748b,#334155);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  }
  .btn-clear-input svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round;}
  .btn-clear-input.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}

  /* ปุ่มลัดจำนวนเงิน */
  .quick-amount{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  .quick-btn{
    flex:1;padding:12px 0;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--glass-2);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:14px;color:var(--text-soft);cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-md), var(--inner-light);
  }
  .quick-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sheen);pointer-events:none;}

  .action-btn-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
  .btn-qr-show,.btn-submit{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    height:60px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:18px;
    font-size:16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:#fff;
    text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  }
  .btn-qr-show::before,.btn-submit::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.38),rgba(255,255,255,.06) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 62%);pointer-events:none;}
  .btn-qr-show svg,.btn-submit svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .btn-qr-show span,.btn-submit span{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .btn-qr-show{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#38bdf8,#2563eb 60%,#1e40af);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(37,99,235,.5), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55), inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
  .btn-submit{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#34d399,#10b981 60%,#047857);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,185,129,.5), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55), inset 0 -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}

  /* Edit Banner */
  .edit-banner {
    display: none;
    background: linear-gradient(150deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
    color: #fff; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius);
    margin-bottom: 12px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
    animation: fadeUp .3s ease-out;
  }
  .edit-banner button {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    color: #fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     หน้ารายการ
     ============================================================ */
  .summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .summary-card{padding:16px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;}
  .summary-card > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .summary-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .summary-title svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
  .summary-value{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;}
  .summary-value.highlight{color:var(--warning);text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(245,158,11,.45);}
  .summary-value.total{color:var(--c-sky);text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(56,189,248,.45);}

  .section-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;padding:13px 14px;}
  .section-header > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .section-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text);}
  .section-title svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
  .header-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;}
  .btn-export,.btn-reset,.btn-cleanup,.btn-zip{padding:10px 13px;border-radius:13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);white-space:nowrap;}
  .btn-export svg,.btn-reset svg,.btn-cleanup svg,.btn-zip svg{stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
  .btn-export{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#22c55e,#12a150 60%,#0b7038);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(18,161,80,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);}
  .btn-zip{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fbbf24,#d97706 60%,#92400e);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(217,119,6,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);}
  .btn-reset{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fb7185,#e11d48 60%,#9f1239);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(225,29,72,.42), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);}

  .record-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px;padding-bottom:8px;}
  .record-item{padding:16px 16px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;animation:popIn .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);}
  .record-item > *{position:relative;z-index:1;}
  .record-item::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:6px;z-index:2;}
  .record-item.pending::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fcd34d,#f59e0b);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(245,158,11,.75);}
  .record-item.cleared::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6ee7b7,#10b981);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(16,185,129,.7);}
  .record-item.cleared{opacity:.62;}
  .record-item.pending .amount{color:var(--warning);}
  .record-item.cleared .amount{color:var(--text-muted);}

  .record-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding-left:6px;}
  .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;flex:1;}
  .amount{font-size:23px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;margin-top:3px;}

  .tag{padding:4px 9px;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border:1px solid;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);}
  .tag svg{width:12px;height:12px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
  .tag-pump{background:rgba(148,163,184,.18);color:var(--text-soft);border-color:rgba(148,163,184,.4);}
  .tag-gas95{background:rgba(249,115,22,.20);color:#fb923c;border-color:rgba(249,115,22,.45);}
  .tag-e20{background:rgba(16,185,129,.20);color:#34d399;border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.45);}
  .tag-b7{background:rgba(59,130,246,.20);color:#60a5fa;border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.45);}
  .tag-card{background:rgba(139,92,246,.20);color:#a78bfa;border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.45);}
  .tag-phone{background:rgba(14,165,233,.20);color:#38bdf8;border-color:rgba(14,165,233,.45);}
  .tag-slip{background:rgba(234,179,8,.20);color:#facc15;border-color:rgba(234,179,8,.45);}
  body.light-mode .tag-gas95{color:#c2410c}
  body.light-mode .tag-e20{color:#047857}
  body.light-mode .tag-b7{color:#1d4ed8}
  body.light-mode .tag-card{color:#6d28d9}
  body.light-mode .tag-phone{color:#0369a1}
  body.light-mode .tag-slip{color:#a16207}

let sfxCtx = null;
function ensureSfx(){
  try{
    if(!sfxCtx) sfxCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(sfxCtx.state === 'suspended') sfxCtx.resume();
  }catch(e){}
  return sfxCtx;
}
function tone(freq, dur, type, vol){
  const ctx = ensureSfx();
  if(!ctx) return;
  try{
    const o = ctx.createOscillator();
    const g = ctx.createGain();
    o.type = type || 'sine';
    o.frequency.value = freq;
    const t = ctx.currentTime;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.08, t + 0.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
  }catch(e){}
}

const DB_NAME = 'pumpTransferDB';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE = 'records';

function openDB(){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if(!('indexedDB' in window)){ reject(new Error('no-idb')); return; }
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    req.onupgradeneeded = e => {
      const db = e.target.result;
      if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath:'id' });
    };
    req.onsuccess = e => resolve(e.target.result);
    req.onerror   = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}
function idbGetAll(){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = idbDB.transaction(STORE,'readonly').objectStore(STORE).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    req.onerror   = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}
function idbPut(record){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = idbDB.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE).put(record);
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}
function idbDeleteOne(id){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = idbDB.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE).delete(id);
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}
function idbDeleteMany(ids){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = idbDB.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE);
    ids.forEach(id => store.delete(id));
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}
function idbClearAll(){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = idbDB.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE).clear();
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

async function openLiveScanner(){
  if(!window.isSecureContext){
    showToast('กล้องใช้ได้เฉพาะเมื่อเปิดผ่าน https:// หรือ localhost'); return;
  }
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){
    showToast('เบราว์เซอร์นี้ไม่รองรับการเรียกกล้อง'); return;
  }
  liveScannerModal.classList.add('active');
  setScanStatus('กำลังขอสิทธิ์ใช้กล้อง...');

  try{
    liveStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video:{ facingMode:{ ideal:'environment' }, width:{ ideal:1280 }, height:{ ideal:720 } },
      audio:false
    });
  }catch(err){
    let msg = 'เปิดกล้องไม่สำเร็จ';
    if(err.name === 'NotAllowedError')      msg = 'ถูกปฏิเสธสิทธิ์กล้อง — กดไอคอนแม่กุญแจข้าง URL แล้วอนุญาต Camera';
    else if(err.name === 'NotFoundError')   msg = 'ไม่พบกล้องบนอุปกรณ์นี้';
    else if(err.name === 'NotReadableError')msg = 'กล้องถูกแอปอื่นใช้อยู่ ปิดแอปกล้องแล้วลองใหม่';
    else if(err.name === 'SecurityError')   msg = 'หน้านี้ถูกฝังอยู่ใน iframe ที่ไม่อนุญาตกล้อง กรุณาเปิดลิงก์ตรงในเบราว์เซอร์';
    showToast(msg); closeLiveScanner(); return;
  }

  videoEl.srcObject = liveStream;
  videoEl.setAttribute('playsinline','');
  try{ await videoEl.play(); }catch(e){}

  if('BarcodeDetector' in window){
    try{
      const supported = await window.BarcodeDetector.getSupportedFormats();
      const want = ['code_128','code_39','codabar','ean_13','itf','qr_code'].filter(f => supported.includes(f));
      const detector = new window.BarcodeDetector({ formats: want.length ? want : supported });
      setScanStatus('เล็งบาร์โค้ดให้อยู่ในกรอบ');
      scanInterval = setInterval(async () => {
        try{
          const codes = await detector.detect(videoEl);
          if(codes.length) handleRawScan(codes[0].rawValue);
        }catch(e){}
      }, 350);
      return;
    }catch(e){ /* ตกไปใช้ ZXing */ }
  }

  setScanStatus('กำลังเตรียมตัวอ่านบาร์โค้ด...');
  try{
    const ZX = await loadZXing();
    const hints = new Map();
    hints.set(ZX.DecodeHintType.POSSIBLE_FORMATS, [
      ZX.BarcodeFormat.CODE_128, ZX.BarcodeFormat.CODE_39, ZX.BarcodeFormat.CODABAR,
      ZX.BarcodeFormat.ITF, ZX.BarcodeFormat.EAN_13, ZX.BarcodeFormat.QR_CODE
    ]);
    hints.set(ZX.DecodeHintType.TRY_HARDER, true);
    zxingReader = new ZX.MultiFormatReader();
    zxingReader.setHints(hints);
    scanCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    setScanStatus('เล็งบาร์โค้ดให้อยู่ในกรอบ');
    scanInterval = setInterval(() => decodeFrameWithZXing(ZX), 320);
  }catch(e){
    showToast('เครื่องนี้อ่านบาร์โค้ดอัตโนมัติไม่ได้ กรุณาพิมพ์เลข 16 หลักแทน');
    closeLiveScanner();
  }
}

function decodeFrameWithZXing(ZX){
  if(zxingBusy || !videoEl.videoWidth) return;
  zxingBusy = true;
  try{
    const w = videoEl.videoWidth, h = videoEl.videoHeight;
    scanCanvas.width = w; scanCanvas.height = h;
    const ctx = scanCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently:true });
    ctx.drawImage(videoEl, 0, 0, w, h);
    const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
    const lum = new ZX.RGBLuminanceSource(toLuminanceArray(data), w, h);
    const bitmap = new ZX.BinaryBitmap(new ZX.HybridBinarizer(lum));
    const result = zxingReader.decode(bitmap);
    if(result) handleRawScan(result.getText());
  }catch(e){ /* ยังไม่เจอโค้ดในเฟรมนี้ */ }
  finally{ zxingReader && zxingReader.reset && zxingReader.reset(); zxingBusy = false; }
}
function toLuminanceArray(imgData){
  const d = imgData.data, out = new Uint8ClampedArray(imgData.width * imgData.height * 4);
  out.set(d);
  return out;
}

function handleRawScan(raw){
  const val = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if(val.length >= 16){ handleSuccessfulLiveScan(val.substring(0,16)); }
  else { setScanStatus(`อ่านได้ ${val.length} หลัก — ต้องการ 16 หลัก ลองเลื่อนกล้องอีกนิด`); }
}

  scanInterval = null; zxingBusy = false;
  if(liveStream) liveStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
  liveStream = null;

function calculateCRC16(data){
  let crc = 0xFFFF;
  for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){
    crc ^= (data.charCodeAt(i) << 8);
    for(let j=0;j<8;j++){ crc = (crc & 0x8000) ? ((crc<<1)^0x1021)&0xFFFF : (crc<<1)&0xFFFF; }
  }
  return ("0000"+crc.toString(16).toUpperCase()).slice(-4);
}
function generatePromptPayPayload(amount){
  const STATIC_PAYLOAD = "00020101021130820016A00000067701011201150107537000882050219BG094353WQ20000939H0316PTTTUNGYANGDAENG53037645802TH62080704000063042BAF";
  if(!amount || amount <= 0) return STATIC_PAYLOAD;
  let payload = "00020101021230820016A00000067701011201150107537000882050219BG094353WQ20000939H0316PTTTUNGYANGDAENG5303764";
  const amtStr = Number(amount).toFixed(2);
  payload += "54" + ("0"+amtStr.length).slice(-2) + amtStr + "5802TH6208070400006304";
  return payload + calculateCRC16(payload);

function buildAnalysis(){
  const n = records.length;
  const amts = records.map(r => r.amount).sort((a,b) => a-b);
  const total = amts.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0);
  const avg = n ? total/n : 0;
  const median = !n ? 0 : (n%2 ? amts[(n-1)/2] : (amts[n/2-1]+amts[n/2])/2);

  const byOil = {}, byPump = {}, byHour = {};
  let cleared=0, lineSent=0, withSlip=0, withCard=0, withPhone=0;
  records.forEach(r => {
    byOil[r.oilType] = byOil[r.oilType] || {c:0,s:0};
    byOil[r.oilType].c++; byOil[r.oilType].s += r.amount;
    byPump[r.pump] = byPump[r.pump] || {c:0,s:0};
    byPump[r.pump].c++; byPump[r.pump].s += r.amount;
    const h = (r.time || '').split(':')[0] || '-';
    byHour[h] = byHour[h] || {c:0,s:0};
    byHour[h].c++; byHour[h].s += r.amount;
    if(r.cleared) cleared++;
    if(r.lineSent) lineSent++;
    if(r.slipImage) withSlip++;
    if(r.phone && r.phone.length === 16) withCard++;
    else if(r.phone && r.phone.length === 10) withPhone++;
  });
  const pct = x => n ? +( (x/n*100).toFixed(1) ) : 0;
  return { n, total, avg, median, min: amts[0]||0, max: amts[n-1]||0,
           byOil, byPump, byHour, cleared, lineSent, withSlip, withCard, withPhone, pct };
}

/* ฟังก์ชันคำนวณความกว้างคอลัมน์ให้อัตโนมัติ (Auto-Fit) */
function getColWidths(dataRows) {
  let widths = [];
  for (let row of dataRows) {
    if (!row) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
      let cell = row[i];
      let val = cell && cell.v !== undefined ? cell.v : cell;
      if (val === null || val === undefined) val = '';
      let str = String(val);
      let lines = str.split('\n');
      let maxLineLen = 0;
      for (let line of lines) {
         if (line.length > maxLineLen) maxLineLen = line.length;
      }
      // เผื่อความกว้างไว้เล็กน้อย (ขั้นต่ำ 10 สูงสุดไม่เกิน 60 ป้องกันล้นจอเกินความจำเป็น)
      let w = Math.min(Math.max(maxLineLen + 4, 10), 60);
      if (!widths[i]) widths[i] = { wch: w };
      else if (w > widths[i].wch) widths[i].wch = w;
    }
  }
  return widths;
}

async function exportZipAll(){
  if(records.length === 0){ showToast('ไม่มีข้อมูลให้ Export'); return; }
  if(typeof XLSX === 'undefined'){ showToast('โหลดระบบ Excel ไม่สำเร็จ ลองรีเฟรชหน้าแล้วลองใหม่'); return; }

  const zipBtn = document.getElementById('btnZipExport');
  const zipBtnLabel = zipBtn ? zipBtn.innerHTML : null;
  if(zipBtn){ zipBtn.disabled = true; zipBtn.style.opacity = '.6'; }
  showToast('กำลังเตรียมไฟล์ ZIP...');

  try{
    const JSZipLib = await loadJSZip();
    const zip = new JSZipLib();
    const dateStr = getLocalDateString(new Date());

    const wb = buildWorkbook();
    const xlsxBinary = XLSX.write(wb, { bookType:'xlsx', type:'array' });
    zip.file(`สรุปยอดโอน_${dateStr}.xlsx`, xlsxBinary);

    const imgFolder = zip.folder('slips');
    let imgCount = 0;
    records.forEach((r, idx) => {
      if(r.slipImage){
        const commaIdx = r.slipImage.indexOf(',');
        const base64Data = commaIdx >= 0 ? r.slipImage.slice(commaIdx + 1) : r.slipImage;
        const filename = r.slipFilename || `slip_${idx+1}.jpg`;
        imgFolder.file(filename, base64Data, { base64:true });
        imgCount++;
      }
    });

    const blob = await zip.generateAsync({ type:'blob', compression:'DEFLATE', compressionOptions:{ level:6 } },
      meta => { if(zipBtn) zipBtn.textContent = `กำลังบีบอัด ${Math.round(meta.percent)}%`; }
    );

    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `รายงานยอดโอน_${dateStr}.zip`;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();

    showToast(imgCount > 0
      ? `ดาวน์โหลด ZIP สำเร็จ (Excel + รูป ${imgCount} รูป)`
      : 'ดาวน์โหลด ZIP สำเร็จ (Excel — ยังไม่มีรูปสลิปในรอบนี้)');
  }catch(err){
    showToast('สร้างไฟล์ ZIP ไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาลองใหม่');
  }finally{
    if(zipBtn){ zipBtn.disabled = false; zipBtn.style.opacity = ''; if(zipBtnLabel) zipBtn.innerHTML = zipBtnLabel; }
  }
}

function exportCSVFallback(){

function renderList(){
  recordList.innerHTML = '';
  if(records.length === 0){
    pendingCount.textContent = '0 รายการ';
    totalAmount.textContent = '฿0';
    navBadgeCount.classList.remove('show');
    recordList.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">${ICONS.empty}<p>ยังไม่มีรายการบันทึกในรอบนี้</p></div>`;
    return;
  }

  let pending = 0, total = 0;
  records.forEach(item => {
    if(!item.cleared) pending++;
    total += item.amount;

    const oilClass = item.oilType === 'E20' ? 'tag-e20' : item.oilType === 'B7' ? 'tag-b7' : 'tag-gas95';
    
    // ปุ่มต่างๆ ซ่อนแสดงตามตั้งค่า
    const slipBtn  = (item.slipImage && showSlipBtn) ? `<button class="r-btn slip" onclick="downloadSlip(${item.id})" title="โหลดสลิป">${ICONS.down}</button>` : '';
    const viewBtn  = showViewBtn ? `<button class="r-btn view" onclick="openRecordView(${item.id})" title="ดูรายละเอียด">${ICONS.eye}</button>` : '';
    const editBtn  = showEditBtn ? `<button class="r-btn edit" onclick="openEditMode(${item.id})" title="แก้ไขรายการ">${ICONS.edit}</button>` : '';
    const delBtn   = showDeleteBtn ? `<button class="r-btn del" onclick="deleteRecord(${item.id})" title="ลบรายการ">${ICONS.trash}</button>` : '';

    const slipTag  = item.slipImage ? `<span class="tag tag-slip">${ICONS.clip} สลิป</span>` : '';
    let memberTag = '';
    if(item.phone){
      memberTag = item.phone.length === 16
        ? `<span class="tag tag-card">${ICONS.card} ${item.phone}</span>`
        : `<span class="tag tag-phone">${ICONS.phone} ${item.phone}</span>`;
    }
    if(item.note) memberTag += `<span class="tag tag-slip">หมายเหตุ</span>`;
    if(item.extraText) memberTag += `<span class="tag tag-pump">หลายรายการ</span>`;
    if(item.needContact) memberTag += `<span class="tag tag-slip">ต้องติดต่อ</span>`;


    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `record-item glass ${item.cleared ? 'cleared' : 'pending'}`;
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="record-top">
        <div class="tags">
          <span class="tag tag-pump">${item.pump}</span>
          <span class="tag ${oilClass}">${item.oilType}</span>
          ${slipTag} ${memberTag}
        </div>
        <div class="amount">฿${item.amount.toLocaleString()}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="record-bottom">
        <div class="record-time">${ICONS.clock} ${item.time}</div>
        <div class="record-actions">
          ${viewBtn}
          ${editBtn}
          ${slipBtn}
          ${lineEnabled ? `<button class="r-btn line ${item.lineSent ? 'sent' : ''}" onclick="shareToLine(${item.id})">${ICONS.send}${item.lineSent ? 'ส่งแล้ว' : 'LINE'}</button>` : ''}
          <button class="r-btn status ${item.cleared ? 'cleared' : 'pending'}" onclick="toggleStatus(${item.id})" title="${item.cleared ? 'เคลียร์แล้ว' : 'รอเคลียร์'}">${item.cleared ? ICONS.check : ICONS.hour}</button>
          ${delBtn}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    recordList.appendChild(el);
  });

  pendingCount.textContent = `${pending} รายการ`;
  totalAmount.textContent = `฿${total.toLocaleString()}`;
  if(pending > 0){ navBadgeCount.textContent = pending; navBadgeCount.classList.add('show'); }
  else navBadgeCount.classList.remove('show');
}

(function bindFastPad(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('padGrid');
  if(!grid) return;
  let lastTs = 0;
  const fire = (btn) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if(now - lastTs < 20) return;
    lastTs = now;
    const d = btn.getAttribute('data-pad');
    if(d === 'bl') padBottomLeft();
    else if(d === 'bs') padBackspace();
    else if(d != null) padPress(d);
  };
  grid.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.numpad-key');
    if(!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    fire(btn);
  }, {passive:false});
})();

function openRecordView(id) {
  const item = records.find(r => r.id === id);
  if(!item) return;

  // เอาทศนิยมออกแบบ UI หลัก
  document.getElementById('vd-amount').textContent = item.amount.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('vd-pump').textContent = item.pump;
  document.getElementById('vd-oil').textContent = item.oilType;
  
  let memberText = 'ไม่ได้ระบุ';
  if(item.phone) {
    memberText = item.phone.length === 16 ? groupCardDigits(item.phone) : groupPhoneDigits(item.phone);
    document.getElementById('vd-member-label').textContent = item.phone.length === 16 ? 'บัตรสมาชิก (Blue Card)' : 'เบอร์โทรศัพท์ลูกค้า';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('vd-member-label').textContent = 'ข้อมูลลูกค้า';
  }
  document.getElementById('vd-member').textContent = memberText;
  
  document.getElementById('vd-datetime').textContent = `${item.date} ${item.time}`;
  document.getElementById('vd-note').textContent = item.note || '-';
  
  const st = document.getElementById('vd-status');
  st.textContent = item.cleared ? 'แจ้งแคชเชียร์แล้ว' : 'รอแจ้งแคชเชียร์';
  st.style.color = item.cleared ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b';

  const extraRow = document.getElementById('vd-extra-row');
  if(item.extraText && item.extraText !== '-') {
    extraRow.style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('vd-extra').textContent = item.extraText;
  } else {
    extraRow.style.display = 'none';
  }

  document.getElementById('viewRecordModal').classList.add('active');
}

function closeRecordView() {
  document.getElementById('viewRecordModal').classList.remove('active');
}
